lines.text: We clean food processing plants and need customized sanitization checklist templates.
We will configure up to ten custom workflows within fourteen days.
Our shift supervisors need dedicated admin walkthrough sessions.
We will provide two admin training sessions completed within seven days.
Could shift supervisors customize their tablet roster view on the fly?
I will check if we can adjust the mobile shift views in an upcoming patch.
Fair enough. That covers our primary requirements.
